fees.description:
A $8.58 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move).
You may need to pay charges a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including metering-related charges not covered by Supply or Usage Charges. More at www.originenergy.com.au/1612/Additional-charges

gasContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.
